title: Space bound after embedding a run
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols, let $r\in\mathbb{N}$, let $\mathrm{dec}:\mathbb{N}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, and let $x$ be a finite Boolean input. Suppose there is a natural number $S$ such that, for every Boolean choice word, the space used by $N$ on that word from its initial configuration on $x$ is at most $S$. If an amplified configuration $D$ has every work-tape head within distance $S$ of cell $0$, then for every run index $j<r+1$, counter $c<r+2$, and Boolean choice word $u$, the configuration obtained by embedding the run of $N$ on $u$ from its initial configuration into block $j$ of $D$ also has every work-tape head within distance $S$ of cell $0$.
